# Link Terminology

## Terms

This glossary lists backlinks, semantic links, graph view, relation labels, bidirectional references, note clusters, and common words used when describing knowledge connections. It helps a team speak clearly about link structures and graph features without arguing over naming every time.

## Reference Guidance

The note explains how people use words such as relationship, graph, connection, backlink, bridge, cluster, and semantic neighborhood. It may sound similar to a relationship guide because the same vocabulary appears in both places, but this document stays at the level of terminology.

## Scope Boundary

It helps with naming, but it is not the note that teaches how to move across notes by idea, how to choose meaningful conceptual bridges, or how to build a map that is genuinely easier to navigate.
